newsitem.title: FINLAND: METSA-SERLA TO UP FINE PAPER PRICES - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: METSA-SERLA TO UP FINE PAPER PRICES - PAPER.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Metsa-Serla plans to hike its fine paper prices by some 10 percent at the start of September, especially in Germany and France, business daily Kauppalehti reported on Wednesday.
It quoted Metsa-Serla paper division sales director Henrik Serlachius as saying that rising sterling would keep UK prices almost unchanged.
Finland's UPM-Kymmene and Enso, and Swedish Stora have earlier announced plans to raise fine paper prices.
